title: Decision tree leaf count
statement: Let $\Omega$ be finite, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree with alphabet $\Omega$ and labels $\alpha$. Its leaf count is $1$ for a leaf; at a query, it is the sum of the leaf counts of the child trees over all answers in $\Omega$.
